1999 December 27, Markie Mickey Durden-Porter, “Pinnochio (oops, kinda long post)”, in alt.fan.lea-salonga (Usenet):

He rubs against the rough spot deep inside that makes me want to groan loud enough that the whole city will hear. I grind my teeth to keep quiet. "I can't remember exactly what I did...was it this?" "Hnnng," I agree. His thumb circles my clit, and every muscle in my body tenses. "What do you think?" he whispers. "Can I see you lose control like that again? Come for me like you did on the plane?"
